question: Did the 14 May 2021 GR change the Maha DBT disbursement process?
gold_answer: No. It reconstitutes the state-level DBT Working Committee (first set up by a GR of 16-09-2016 not in this corpus). The disbursement process of 12-10-2018 was amended only by the GR of 30-11-2021 (paragraphs 8 and 9)
